# uml-overview-pages

The UML overview PAGES — one per instance and one per declared sub-graph, written by `scripts/gen-uml-overview.ts` (its `DOCS_ROOT`, line 74) and never by hand. 134 files on `main` at the time of declaring. `auto-docs` rather than a kind of its own, on the same argument as `beans.json`'s `defs` and `archive` both declaring `bean-defs`: a sub-graph's identity is its directory id, and a kind per writer would be a registry entry restating one sentence. **The path is `uml/overview`, never `uml`, and that is load-bearing**: `cat-harness/uml/` holds this generator's 266 `.puml`/`.mmd` files PLUS `harness-object-model.puml`, `harness-schemas.puml` and a README from other writers, and `docs/assets/img/uml/` holds four SVGs from `gen-object-model-uml.ts` beside the 266 under `overview/`. One writer per directory holds at the `overview` level and fails one level up. Bean `xsrv`; no `storage` is set here — see the sibling entry. The id is `uml-overview-pages` rather than the obvious `uml-overview` because that name is already a skill (`skills/kg/kg-core/uml-overview`) and a Tool node; a directory id and a skill id may well be separate namespaces, but a declaration is not the place to find out.

Part of [C@T Harness](../../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `uml-overview-pages`, holding `auto-docs`.
